property: migration of interface/address/route/neighbor administration from classic ifconfig/route/arp commands to iproute2 object-oriented commands

sources.supports: Explicitly maps obsolete net-tools commands to iproute2 replacements.
Explains modern iproute2 control role and inadequacy of older ifconfig/route model.
Shows old ifconfig alias convention retained only for compatibility while iproute2 supports multiple addresses directly.

negative_claims: This is not a direct net-tools source-code fork into iproute2.
Old utilities did not disappear at a single date and still survive for compatibility.
open_questions: Pin first iproute2 release and distro migration timelines.
notes: Operational role migration with long coexistence, not clean replacement at one date.
